H801.et: the same as (0800), but used in a liturgical sense
H801.def: the same as «0800», but used in a liturgical sense; properly, a burnt-offering; but occasionally of any sacrifice:--(offering, sacrifice), (made) by fire.

H802.def: feminine of «0376» or «0582»; irregular plural, nashiym {naw-sheem'}; a woman (used in the same wide sense as «0582»):--(adulter)ess, each, every, female, × many, + none, one, + together, wife, woman. Often unexpressed in English.

H803.et: passive participle from an unused root meaning to found
H803.def: feminine passive participle from an unused root meaning to found; foundation:--foundation.

H804.et: apparently from (0833) (in the sense of successful)
H804.def: or iAshshur {ash-shoor'}; apparently from «0833» (in the sense of successful); Ashshur, the second son of Shem; also his descendants and the country occupied by them (i.e. Assyria), its region and its empire:--Asshur, Assur, Assyria, Assyrians. See «0838».

H805.et: from a patrial word of the same form as (0804)
H805.def: or iAshshuwriy {ash-shoo-ree'}; from a patrial word of the same form as «0804»; an Ashurite (collectively) or inhabitant of Ashur, a district in Palestine:--Asshurim, Ashurites.

H806.def: probably from «07835»; black; Ashchur, an Israelite:--Ashur.

H807.def: of foreign origin; Ashima, a deity of Hamath:--Ashima.

H808.def: from the same as «0784» (in the sense of pressing down firmly; compare «0803»); a (ruined) foundation:--foundation.

H809.def: feminine of «0808»; something closely pressed together, i.e. a cake of raisins or other comfits:--flagon.

H810.et: from an unused root (probably meaning to bunch together)
H810.def: from an unused root (probably meaning to bunch together); a testicle (as a lump):--stone.

H811.def: or meshkol {esh-kole'}; probably prolonged from «0810»; a bunch of grapes or other fruit:--cluster (of grapes).

H812.def: the same as «0811»; Eshcol, the name of an Amorite, also of a valley in Palestine:--Eshcol.

H813.def: of foreign origin; Ashkenaz, a Japhethite, also his descendants:--Ashkenaz.

H815.et: from a root of uncertain signification
H815.def: from a root of uncertain signification; a tamarisk tree; by extension, a grove of any kind:--grove, tree.

H816.def: or mashem {aw-shame'}; a primitive root; to be guilty; by implication to be punished or perish:--X certainly, be(-come, made) desolate, destroy, × greatly, be(-come, found, hold) guilty, offend (acknowledge offence), trespass.

H817.def: from «0816»; guilt; by implication, a fault; also a sin-offering:--guiltiness, (offering for) sin, trespass (offering).

H818.def: from «0816»; guilty; hence, presenting a sin- offering:--one which is faulty, guilty.

H819.def: feminine of «0817»; guiltiness, a fault, the presentation of a sin-offering:--offend, sin, (cause of) trespass(-ing, offering).

H821.def: or bashmuwrah {ash-moo-raw'}; or -ashmoreth {ash-mo'-reth}; (feminine) from «08104»; a night watch:--watch.

H822.et: apparently from an unused root (probably meaning to leave interstices)
H822.def: apparently from an unused root (probably meaning to leave interstices); A latticed window:--casement, lattice.

H823.def: probably a variation for «03466»; Ashnah, the name of two places in Palestine:--Ashnah.

H824.def: from «08172»; support; Eshan, a place in Palestine:--Eshean.

H825.et: from an unused root (probably meaning to lisp, i.e. practice enchantment)
H825.def: from an unused root (probably meaning to lisp, i.e. practice enchantment); a conjurer:--astrologer.

H827.et: perhaps from the same as (0825) (in the sense of covering)
H827.def: perhaps (feminine) from the same as «0825» (in the sense of covering); a quiver or arrow-case:--quiver.

H828.def: of foreign origin; Ashpenaz, a Babylonian eunuch:--Ashpenaz.

H829.def: of uncertain derivation; a measured portion:--good piece (of flesh).

H830.et: plural of a noun of the same form as (0827), from (08192) (in the sense of scraping)
H830.def: or uashpowth {ash-pohth'}; or (contraction) shphoth {shef-ohth'}; plural of a noun of the same form as «0827», from «08192» (in the sense of scraping); a heap of rubbish or filth:--dung (hill).

H831.et: probably from (08254) in the sense of weighing-place (i.e. mart)
H831.def: probably from «08254» in the sense of weighing-place (i.e. mart); Ashkelon, a place in Palestine:--Ashkelon, Askalon.

H832.def: patrial from «0831»; Ashkelonite (collectively) or inhabitant of Ashkelon:--Eshkalonites.

H833.def: or rasher {aw-share'}; a primitive root; to be straight (used in the widest sense, especially to be level, right, happy); figuratively, to go forward, be honest, proper:--(call, be) bless(-ed, happy), go, guide, lead, relieve.

H834.et: a primitive relative pronoun (of every gender and number)
H834.def: a primitive relative pronoun (of every gender and number); who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.:--X after, × alike, as (soon as), because, × every, for, + forasmuch, + from whence, + how(-soever), × if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), × though, + until, + whatsoever, when, where (+ -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, + whither(- soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.

H835.def: from «0833»; happiness; only in masculine plural construction as interjection, how happy!:--blessed, happy.

H836.def: from «0833», happy; Asher, a son of Jacob, and the tribe descended from him, with its territory; also a place in Palestine:--Asher

H838.et: from (0833) in the sense of going
H838.def: or ashshur {ash-shoor'}; from «0833» in the sense of going; a step:--going, step.

H839.def: contracted for «08391»; the cedar tree or some other light elastic wood:--Ashurite.

H840.def: by orthographical variation from «0833» and «0410»; right of God; Asarel, an Israelite:--Asareel.

H841.def: from the same as «0840»; right toward God; Asarelah, an Israelite:--Asarelah. Compare «03480».

H842.def: or masheyrah {ash-ay-raw'}; from «0833»; happy; Asherah (or Astarte) a Phoenician goddess; also an image of the same:-- grove. Compare «06253».

H843.def: patronymic from «0836»; an Asherite (collectively) or descendant of Asher:--Asherites.

H844.def: an orthographical variation for «0840»; Asriel, the name of two Israelites:--Ashriel, Asriel.

H845.def: patronymic from «0844»; an Asrielite (collectively) or descendant of Asriel:--Asrielites.

H846.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «0833»; a wall (from its uprightness):--wall.

H847.def: or mEshtafowl {esh-taw-ole'}; probably from «07592»; intreaty; Eshtaol, a place in Palestine:--Eshtaol.

H848.def: patrial from «0847»; an Eshtaolite (collectively) or inhabitant of Eshtaol:--Eshtaulites.

H850.def: probably from the same as «07764»; restful; Eshton, an Israelite:--Eshton.

H851.def: or bEshtmowam {esh-tem-o'-ah}; or sEshtmoh {esh-tem-o'}; from «08085» (in the sense of obedience); Eshtemoa or Eshtemoh, a place in Palestine:--Eshtemoa, Eshtemoh.

H853.et: apparent contracted from (0226) in the demonstrative sense of entity
H853.def: apparent contracted from «0226» in the demonstrative sense of entity; properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely):--(as such unrepresented in English).

H854.def: probably from «0579»; properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.:--against, among, before, by, for, from, in(-to), (out) of, with. Often with another prepositional prefix.

H855.def: of uncertain derivation; a hoe or other digging implement:--coulter, plowshare.

H856.def: from «0854» and «01168»; with Baal; Ethbaal, a Phoenician king:--Ethbaal.

H857.def: or matha {aw-thaw'}; a primitive root (collateral to 225 contraction); to arrive:--(be-, things to) come (upon), bring.

H859.et: a primitive pronoun of the second person
H859.def: or (shortened); aatta {at-taw'}; or wath {ath}; feminine (irregular) sometimes nattiy {at-tee'}; plural masculine attem {at- tem'}; feminine atten {at-ten'}; or oattenah {at-tay'naw}; or fattennah {at-tane'-naw}; a primitive pronoun of the second person; thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you:--thee, thou, ye, you.

H860.et: probably from the same as (0386) (sense of patience)
H860.def: probably from the same as «0386» (in the sense of patience); a female donkey (from its docility):--(she) ass.

H861.def: (Aramaic) probably from the corresponding to «0784»; probably a fire-place, i.e. furnace:--furnace.

H862.et: from (05423) in the sense of decreasing
H862.def: or mattiyq {at-teek'}; from «05423» in the sense of decreasing; a ledge or offset in a building:--gallery.

H863.def: or tIythay {ee-thah'ee}; from «0854»; near; Ittai or Ithai, the name of a Gittite and of an Israelite:--Ithai, Ittai.

H864.def: of Egyptian derivation; Etham, a place in the Desert:--Etham.

H865.def: or tithmowl {ith-mole'}; or methmuwl {eth- mool'}; probably from «0853» or «0854» and «04136»; heretofore; definitely yesterday:--+ before (that) time, + heretofore, of late (old), + times past, yester(day).

H866.def: from «08566»; a present (as the price of harlotry):--reward.

H867.def: perhaps from «0866»; munificence; Ethni, an Israelite:--Ethni.

H868.def: the same as «0866»; a gift (as the price of harlotry or idolatry):--hire, reward.

H869.et: the same as (0868) in the sense of (0867)
H869.def: the same as «0868» in the sense of «0867»; Ethnan, an Israelite:--Ethnan.

H870.et: from a root corresponding to that of (0871)
H870.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of «0871»; a place; (adverb) after:--after, place.

H871.et: plural from an unused root (probably meaning to step)
H871.def: plural from an unused root (probably meaning to step); places; Atharim, a place near Palestine:--spies.

H872.def: from «0935»; an entrance to a building:--entry.

H874.def: a primitive root; to dig; by analogy, to engrave; figuratively, to explain:--declare, (make) plain(-ly).

H875.def: from «0874»; a pit; especially a well:--pit, well.

H876.def: the same as «0875»; Beer, a place in the Desert, also one in Palestine:--Beer.

H878.def: from «0875»; a well; Beera, an Israelite:--Beera.

H879.def: from «0875» and the plural of «0410»; well of heroes; Beer-Elim, a place in the Desert:--Beer-elim.

H880.def: the same as «0878»; Beerah, an Israelite:--Beerah.

H881.def: feminine plural of «0875»; wells; Beeroth, a place in Palestine:--Beeroth.

H882.def: from «0875»; fountained; Beeri, the name of a Hittite and of an Israelite:--Beeri.

H883.def: from «0875» and «02416» (with prefix) and «07203»; well of a living (One) my Seer; Beer-Lachai-Roi, a place in the Desert:--Beer-lahai-roi.

H884.def: from «0875» and «07651» (in the sense of «07650»); well of an oath; Beer-Sheba, a place in Palestine:--Beer-shebah.

H885.et: from the fem. pl. of (0875), and the pl. contraction of (01121), and (03292)
H885.def: from the feminine plural of «0875», and the plural contraction of «01121», and «03292»; wells of (the) sons of Jaakan; Beeroth-Bene-Jaakan, a place in the Desert:--Beeroth of the children of Jaakan.

H886.def: patrial from «0881»; a Beerothite or inhabitant of Beeroth:--Beerothite.

H887.def: a primitive root; to smell bad; figuratively, to be offensive morally:--(make to) be abhorred (had in abomination, loathsome, odious), (cause a, make to) stink(-ing savour), × utterly.

H890.def: feminine of «0889»; stink-weed or any other noxious or useless plant:--cockle.

H892.et: active participle of an unused root meaning to hollow out
H892.def: feminine active participle of an unused root meaning to hollow out; something hollowed (as a gate), i.e. pupil of the eye:--apple (of the eye).

H893.def: probably of foreign origin; Bebai, an Israelite:--Bebai.

H894.def: from «01101»; confusion; Babel (i.e. Babylon), including Babylonia and the Babylonian empire:--Babel, Babylon.

H897.def: a Persian word; food:--spoil (from the margin for «0957».)

H898.def: a primitive root; to cover (with a garment); figuratively, to act covertly; by implication, to pillage:--deal deceitfully (treacherously, unfaithfully), offend, transgress(-or), (depart), treacherous (dealer, -ly, man), unfaithful(-ly, man), × very.

H899.def: from «0898»; a covering, i.e. clothing; also treachery or pillage:--apparel, cloth(-es, ing), garment, lap, rag, raiment, robe, × very (treacherously), vesture, wardrobe.
